dimensions.assessment: Affects vessel operators, coastal communities, and commercial maritime stakeholders in fog-impacted areas.
dimensions.evidence: enhance vessel safety and reduce the economic impact of coastal marine fog events

dimensions.assessment: Improves data collection, modeling, and advisories to assist operational decision-making.
dimensions.evidence: increasing the number of marine-based observations through additional Federal platforms and commercially acquired observations

dimensions.assessment: Requires NOAA to develop a project plan and engage stakeholders, but specifies no funding amounts.
Directs a specific agency project and planning process without altering broader statutes permanently.
dimensions.evidence: The Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere shall conduct a project to improve forecasts of coastal marine fog.

dimensions.assessment: Requires a project plan within one year, with ongoing operational improvements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Under Secretary shall develop a plan
